crossRefs.note: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose…
but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’
Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”

people.name: Abigail
people.line: Wife of Nabal, later married David

people.name: Carmel
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: When David’s servants had come to Abigail to Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, “David has sent us to you, to take you to him as wife.”
translations.bsb: When his servants came to Abigail at Carmel, they said, “David has sent us to take you as his wife.”
translations.kjv: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.
translations.asv: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David hath sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.
